definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+D/U glide to each half page instead of jumping like the Bob Refs preview?
definitions.why: Motion keeps your place in a 13-section form, and a held key still pages smoothly

choices.label: A ~0.2 s ease-out glide that shows where the content went; instant under Reduce Motion
An instant jump, identical to the Refs preview; no animation or pending-target state

definitions.ask: Should the Settings window show a slim pinned footer that reads "⌃D Down  ⌃U Up"?
definitions.why: Nobody guesses vim keys in a native Settings window; Bob panels teach keys in footers

choices.label: Pinned footer under a soft scroll-edge blur; the keys are discoverable in place
No footer; only the Keyboard docs teach the keys
